name: Wiki
description: Write wiki pages: typed pages, named relations and a team writing guide
author: Nimbalyst

marketplace.tagline: Keep what your team decided in pages agents can read
marketplace.longDescription: Wiki teaches the agent how to write your project's wiki pages: what people said and decided, written into the page it affects, with the context that helps someone see the whole problem. Pages nest, any page can have a type your team defines (modules, technologies, competitors), and links between typed pages can carry a named relation that both pages list. Setup installs an editable "How we write this wiki" page that people and agents read before writing.
highlights: Guidance for capturing decisions and open questions with who and when
Types your team defines, with a page and a table for each
Named relations between typed pages, written as links in the prose
An editable writing guide the agent reads before it writes

claudePlugin.description: Set up a project's wiki and writing guide, then write pages, types and relations

enablement.purpose: Sort work events for the knowledge graph with TypeSafe's Jev model. Sends event text to api.typesafe.ai or your Cloudflare account's Workers AI only after you save a TypeSafe API key or Cloudflare token.
